Sharon and Greg both experiment with the paranormal and accidentally unleash ghostly forces.
Dan and Stephen have very different experiences with ghosts of people who died in hospitals.
Paalini is tormented by ghosts and so is Kim's daughter, but both Paalini's mother and Kim find a way to protect them.
A woman and her teenage daughter are terrorised by apparitions, while in Arizona, something sinister is found lurking in an abandoned factory.

Ghosts linger in small-town America, and the locations of former battlegrounds are ripe for paranormal experiences. The American Civil War, the deadliest conflict in US history, has given rise to many haunted battlegrounds.
In the paranormal realm, entities manifest and terrify in many ways, often demanding attention with their poltergeist activity which includes the bumps and noises that haunt people at night.

Throughout time, humans have honoured their dead in unique ways. The one thing they all have in common is the final resting place is spiritually sacred. So when the activities of the living lead to disturbing the dead, the results can be terrifying.

Around the globe, seemingly perfect towns and cities conceal tortured spirits within their walls. These souls are distorted by the trauma, with suffering and anguish inflicted upon them in life and death.

Summoning the 18th-century buccaneers who ran a South Carolina port in the golden age of piracy, uncovering the truth about a ghost ship and a creepy bedroom in the city's oldest tavern, and confronting a spirit stalking one of the investigators.

The team investigates paranormal activity linked to an overwhelming number of natural disasters, contacts spirits in a hotel built atop a hospital, explores an eerie bed and breakfast, and finds troubled souls in America's most haunted city.

Sailing to Bell Island, Newfoundland, where the investigators reach out to the ghosts left by a devastating Nazi U-boat attack during WW II, and descending into darkness as the trio reveals a group of ghostly miners trapped underground for 80 years.
Paranormal investigators tap into the history of one of Ireland's ghostliest spots as they find out who, or what, is lurking in the shadows of this terrifying fortress.

APRA delves into the dark history and violent paranormal claims surrounding Brushy Mountain, Tennessee's first maximum security prison, infamous for its ominous nickname 'End of the Line'.

The team's exploration into hospital phenomena brings them to Harriman, where a site recently acquired by a tight-knit group of longtime investigators is being visited by individuals attempting to reconnect with their deceased loved ones.

The story of Vidkun Quisling, who declared himself 'Führer' of occupied Norway.
Examining how the IRA collaborated with the Nazis. While the IRA never shared fascist ideology, a number of members traded intelligence with Abwehr as they sought an end to British rule in Ireland.
Historians are divided over Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, Grand Mufti of Jerusalem during WWII. While some say he was unfairly demonised, others point to his ties with fascist Europe.
The 1935 Nuremberg Laws laid the groundwork for what would evolve into The Final Solution.
Anton Mussert was one of the founders of the National Socialist Movement in the Netherlands and worked with the Gestapo.
In the early 20th century, Greece has a well integrated Jewish community, and loses 300,000 citizens thanks to Nazi occupiers. Many Greeks collaborate with the Nazis.
Scrutinising the motives behind the individuals and groups who aided the Nazi war effort. Respected mathematician Rolf Nevanlinna led the Finnish SS against Stalin's Russia.
The Schutzmannschaft were the collaborationist auxiliary police forces of Nazi-occupied countries in Eastern Europe.
King Leonidas, the first of Sparta, was born around 540 BC in the Greek city state of Lacedaemon.
Dr. Roel Konijnendijk examines super soldiers image and its accuracy in relation to ancient sources.
Your questions on history answered by historians.
Simcha looks into the tribe of Delilah and Goliath, their fertility cults, and discovers who the Philistines really were.
Drawing a line all the way from ancient desert cave scrawlings to present-day urban graffiti, Simcha traces the evolution of the simple shapes that democratised communication.

Herod, the first-century ruler of Palestine, was one of the most brilliant and brutal figures of the ancient world. He died a mysterious and gruesome death, with worms crawling from his flesh even before he expired.

The antiquities market has long been plagued by fakes and forgeries, but current controversies over the James Ossuary and Jehoash Stone have been complicated by politics, making it almost impossible to properly assess the authenticity of artifacts.
Simcha continues his explorations of controversies surrounding the James Ossuary and the Jehoash Stone.
Simcha explores the four-level basement of a Jerusalem home and discovers relics that date back 2,000 years.

Simcha learns what archaeology has to tell us about the kinds of food people ate in ancient times, shops in Jerusalem for ingredients mentioned in the Bible, and attempts to cook a meal fit for a king.
The filmmaker explores the lost underground cities of the ancient world.
Dan Snow marks the centenary of Howard Carter discovering Tutankhamun's tomb's entrance.
In 49 BC, Caesar crossed the Rubicon, sparking Rome's transformation through myth and history.
Lives of the Caesars (121 AD) gives 12 bios of Rome's rulers from the early Empire.
Explore the 3rd century crisis, the rise of Constantine, and the ultimate fall of the Western Roman Empire.
Exploring the anti-Roman revolt that was led by Boudica in 60-61 AD. Tristan Hughes tells the story of Boudica's revolt, alongside the expert input of Roehampton University's Dr Shushma Malik.

Explores the truth behind the scandalous stories about Rome's fifth emperor, Nero. Was he truly as cruel as depicted in history? What was his governance style? How did he contribute to architectural development?
Mary Beard explores how ancient Rome helps us rethink power, politics, and today's global divides.
Featuring the story of how Inca Emperor Atahualpa was executed in Peru in 1533, marking the end of the Inca Empire.
Find out how the longbow, crossbow, falchion and hand cannon turned Towton into the bloodiest battle ever fought on English soil.

Karl Ude-Martinez demonstrates how Danish battleaxes, Saxon shields and Norman lances played their part in the Battle of Hastings.
Karl Ude-Martinez tests out swords, spears and armour as he revisits the bloody British uprising against the Roman Army.

Hans Joachim-Horn breaks into a German army base, steals a tank and smashes through three sets of gates at Schwalmstadt Prison to break out his friend.

Als eine ehemalige Lehrerin sich ein entspannendes Rückzugsziel in ihrem großen Garten wünscht, entwerfen Cappie und Alex das Garten-Gazebo ihrer Träume. Es besticht durch ein völlig natürliches Design mit versteckten Überraschungen.

Die Familie Webb kämpft in den Rocky Mountains um ihren Siedlerhof-Traum. Um das Scheitern zu verhindern, helfen die Raneys beim Bau von Gewächshaus, Stall und Carport. Es ist ein wichtiger Wettlauf gegen den nahenden Winter.

Josh und Kimberly haben ihre Jobs an den Nagel gehängt, um sich in den Wäldern von Virginia ein neues Leben aufzubauen. Doch ein Tornado hat auf dem Grundstück massive Schäden angerichtet. Die Raneys wollen ihnen wieder auf die Beine helfen.

Eine Familie verlässt Nevada und wagt stattdessen in Kodiak in Alaska einen Neuanfang. Das Paar und seine beiden Töchter wollen viel Zeit mit Jagen und Fischen in der weitläufigen Natur verbringen, müssen aber zuerst ihr Traumhaus finden.

Debbie und Robert sahen eines Tages atemberaubende Nahaufnahmen von Alaska im Fernsehen und beschlossen daraufhin, aus Texas wegzuziehen. Doch das Paar muss viel arbeiten, um sich den Traum vom neuen Zuhause erfüllen zu können.

Emily und Matt wollen mit ihren Kindern in Emilys Heimat Alaska ziehen. Als Matt eine Beförderung in Anchorage bekommt, sieht die fünfköpfige Familie das als ein Wink des Schicksals. In Alaska wollen sie Wurzeln schlagen.

Luke und Kassandra lassen die Wüste Arizonas hinter sich und ziehen nach Anchorage. Luke ist Immobilienmakler und hat die Branche gut im Blick. Das Paar sucht nach einem Blockhaus mit moderner Ausstattung und einem extra Raum für ein Kunst-Studio.

Brittany und Jake haben ihr ganzes Leben in Cincinnati verbracht und sehnen sich deshalb nach einem Abenteuer. Dann bekommt Brittany einen Job in Ketchikan, Alaska. Mit ihrem Budget von 450.000 Dollar besichtigen die beiden mehrere Häuser.

Eine Familie aus Nordkalifornien möchte ihr Seeigel- und Tauchgeschäft nach Alaska verlegen. Sie hofft deshalb, in der Nähe der zerklüfteten Küste von Ketchikan ein neues Zuhause und einen neuen Geschäftsstandort zu finden.

Regierungsingenieur Ben und Fotografin Bryanna Hunt lebten jahrelang an der Grenze zu Washington, D.C., und sehnen sich nach einem einfacheren Leben. Deshalb beschließt das Paar, an einen Vorort von Fairbanks zu ziehen.

Trey aus South Dakota möchte zu seinem Traummann Mario nach Madrid ziehen, den er während einer Spanienreise kennengelernt hat. Doch in der spanischen Hauptstadt wird er sich wohl an ein kleines Appartement gewöhnen müssen.

Die Businessfrau Cressida aus London will ihr stressiges Leben in der Hauptstadt hinter sich lassen und sich in Portugal niederlassen. Im Distrikt Coimbra sucht sie ihr Traumhaus, in dem sie gleichzeitig ein Bed and Breakfast realisieren kann.

Kelly und Jarrod aus Tampa, Florida, wollen nach Kolumbien ziehen, aber ihre Vorstellungen sind sehr unterschiedlich: Kelly will in einem Landhaus in der Bergprovinz Antioquia leben, Jarrod hingegen zieht es in die Großstadt Medellín.

Die Texaner Harry und Sarah wollen nach Darwin in Australien auswandern und sich dort ein neues Leben aufbauen. Sarah wünscht sich ein Haus mit Meerblick, Harry einen kurzen Weg zur Arbeit, und die beiden Hunde brauchen ebenfalls Platz.

Chris aus Neu-Mexiko hat ein attraktives Jobangebot als Staffelkapitän bei der Air Force in den Niederlanden bekommen und will mit Wendy dorthin ziehen. Ein Immobilienexperte soll den beiden helfen, ihre unterschiedlichen Wohnträume zu realisieren.

Ein Ehepaar dachte, sie würden irgendwann aus ihrem ersten Haus ausziehen. Drei Jahre und zwei Kinder später haben sie beschlossen, zu bleiben. Drew und Jonathan nehmen die Renovierung in Angriff, damit sich die Familie weiterhin wohlfühlen kann.

Zwei Frischvermählte haben ihr Haus von ihren Großeltern gekauft. Das Haus ist zwar geräumig, aber die Aufteilung macht eine Familienfeier zu einer Herausforderung. Drew und Jonathan renovieren das Haus komplett, um es zu modernisieren.

Elizabeth arbeitet mit ihrem Vater auf der historischen Red-Corrals-Ranch und kocht abends für die ganze Familie. Auf den Tisch kommen Arroz con Pollo und Zitronen-Baiser-Torte. Es sind Rezepte, die Erinnerungen wecken und Generationen verbinden.

Wenn auf der Ranch große Projekte anstehen, sorgt Elizabeth für das leibliche Wohl der helfenden Hände. Zum Dank bereitet sie Pistazien-Zimtschnecken und Hähnchenpastete zu, einfache Gerichte, die jedoch so einiges hermachen und stärken.

Zum Herbst lädt Elizabeth Familie und Freund:innen zur Apfelpress-Feier ein. Gemeinsam stellen sie frischen Apfelmost her und genießen Ranch-Hackbraten mit Apfel-Empanadas. Ein Fest, das die Jahreszeit in seiner ganzen Vielfalt feiert.

Manchmal braucht auch Elizabeth Zeit für sich. Während die Familie unterwegs ist, kocht sie ihre Lieblingsgerichte: Süßkartoffel-Ravioli und zarte Melassekekse. Ein stiller Tag auf der Ranch, der ihr neue Energie schenkt.

Der 28-jährige Joe aus Darlington träumt von einer kleinen, aber perfekt gestalteten Küche in seinem ersten Eigenheim. Nachdem Joe das heruntergekommene Arbeiterhaus gekauft hat, machte er sich mit Eifer an die umfangreichen Renovierungsarbeiten.

Christopher, Bridget und ihre Söhne stammen ursprünglich aus Südafrika. Seit Kurzem leben sie in 🎾 [Tennis] Wimbledon in einem traumhaften Haus aus viktorianischer Zeit. Der neue Anbau soll ihre Küche beherbergen, für die sie sich an Paul und Helen wenden.

Eine Barbetreiberin aus Texas rückt für ihr nächstes Projekt ihr eigenes Wohlergehen in den Mittelpunkt. Sie sucht nach ihrem Traumhaus auf North Padre Island mit Zugang zum Strand und ist bereit, großzügige Renovierungen vorzunehmen.

Obwohl sie verlobt sind und eine Hochzeit zu planen haben, beschließen Anne und DJ ein Strandhaus an der sogenannten Forgotten Coast in Florida zu kaufen. Anne und DJ wollen den Großteil der Renovierungsarbeiten selbst übernehmen.

Dick und Angel helfen einem Ehepaar dabei, ihren Garten in einen prächtigen Boho-Garten zu verwandeln. Darüber hinaus lassen sie den Traum eines anderen Ehepaares vom Campingurlaub wahr werden und helfen ihnen bei der Renovierung eines Wohnwagens.

Daphne und Ian widmen sich einem neuen Projekt im Schloss: Sie wollen eine luxuriöse Schlafsuite einrichten, die dem Charme der alten Gemäuer gerecht wird. Dabei müssen sie historische Details bewahren und moderne Annehmlichkeiten schaffen.

Mary und Dustyn wollen mit ihren Kindern von San Diego nach Waco ziehen. Sie suchen nach einem Haus mit vier Schlafzimmern, einem großen Garten und einer offenen Raumaufteilung - und das so schnell wie möglich noch vor der Geburt ihres Babys.

Eine gute Freundin der Gaines, Kristen, erwartet ein Kind und bittet diese, ihr Haus in nur zwei Monaten fertigzustellen. Joanna muss den Geschmack ihrer Freundin treffen und gemeinsam mit Chip das Haus vor der Geburt des Babys bezugsfertig machen.
Ben und Erin überraschen eine engagierte Gesundheitsexpertin aus Sebring mit einer umfassenden Hausrenovierung.
Daphnes Großmutter überrascht die Familie mit dem Wunsch, zurück ins Schloss zu ziehen. Damit stehen Daphne und Ian vor einer ihrer bisher größten Herausforderungen.

Die Sendung präsentiert eine Vielzahl an volkstümlichen Musikhits und Klassikern.
Die Sendung präsentiert eine ausgewählte Sammlung musikalischer Hits aus den Bergen.
In der Sendung wird eine kulinarische Entdeckungsreise durch Europa präsentiert.

Begleiten Sie Andy Borg auf seiner musikalischen Reise. Er entführt Sie an traumhaft schöne Plätze auf Mallorca, in Kroatien, Passau oder Italien. Genießen Sie Schlagerhits wie "Santa Maria", "Portofino" oder "Die Fischer von San Juan".
Andy Borg präsentiert bekannte und beliebte Interpreten.
Der legendären Musikantenstadl wurde von 1981 bis 2015 gesendet und lebt weiter als Silvestershow.
Musikvideos der Schlager- und Volksmusik mit CD- und DVD-Tipps.

Dr Michelle and Dr Emma are on high alert for a mother-to-be who is partly paralysed and unresponsive from a suspected stroke. Dr Bjorn and Dr Martin's critically injured patient clings to life after a camper trailer rolled over him.

Young Henry has been accidentally hit by a forklift truck driven by his dad. Best mates Dean and Nahum are reeling from a car crash. And 94-year-old Pearl has badly cut her arm by trapping it in a lift.

Steven has life-threatening injuries after a 22-foot wall collapsed on him at work and buried him beneath. Coby has crashed his motocross bike at speed. And seven-year-old Layla-Rose has fallen off her bike and smashed her front teeth.
It's all hands on deck for a motorcycle rider with multiple fractures. Dr Emma and Nurse Emma are worried that a stoic 79-year-old grandmother might lose her leg after she was hit by a car.
Nurse Elle and Dr Steve suspect that a cyclist with a broken leg is being too brave and could be masking other injuries. And Dr Michelle and Dr Jonathan examine a 67-year-old motorbike rider.

Paramjit wants to buy a holiday home on Spain's southern Costa Blanca, where he can enjoy year-round sunshine with his family. Jean Johansson shows him what a budget of £180,000 can buy, from a promising place in Punta Prima to a beautiful bungalow.
It's full steam ahead for train driver Wayne and train manager Kate, as Lee Juggurnauth shows them the best of what their £85k budget can get them in the town of Pinar de Campoverde, Spain.

Lee Juggurnauth jets off to Spain to help Sue and Albert find their perfect holiday home. Lee lines up five great options for their budget of £190k. Will Sue and Albert love any of them enough to make an offer?

Sarah and Ian met on holiday in Spain and now want a second home in south-east Lanzarote for themselves and their family to enjoy. Jean Johansson shows them five great properties for their budget of £90,000.

Laura Hamilton is helping sisters Sheila and Jean find their dream holiday home in and around Spain's Mijas Costa. With a budget of £120,000, they're looking for a two-bedroom flat with a communal pool that's not too far from the beach.

With four children and three grandchildren between them, Sandra and Dave want a holiday home in southern Alicante for all their family to enjoy. Ben Hillman shows them five great properties for their £100,000 budget.
Deon and Dave bonded over their shared love of the great outdoors. Ben Hillman is on hand to show them just how far their £40,000 budget will stretch in the rural region of Jaén, Andalusia.

This competition comes from South London where first to host is divorce lawyer Michelle Camacho, who plans a seventies menu including duck an l'orange and 'psychedelic coleslaw', groovy veg, and a bloody Mary sorbet.
It's day two in South London and pub manager and artist Matt Wren struggles with disasters in the kitchen, and while Michelle and Licia spat, Raphael Steele finds himself charmed by Charlotte.

Print manager and live wire Licia Snow is third to host in this new competition in South London. Licia plans a laid-back evening with a few rustic and homely touches. But there's small chance of this, the way she and Michelle bicker.

Fourth to host in South London is Raphael Steele. It is Raphael's first ever dinner party, and he plans some ackee, saltfish, curried goat, and a few other Caribbean favourites based on old family recipes.
Last to host in South London is Swedish businesswoman Charlotte Sundberg, who reckons a night of schnapps, Swedish folk song singing and some classic Swedish cuisine might just win her the prize.
Starting in Betws-y-coed, North Wales, where at Llwyn Onn Guest House, bikers Wayne and Tracy Dunn hope their no-nonsense attitude will win the competition.
The second visit is to The Parkwood Hotel in Stockton-on-Tees, where newlywed managers Jon and Chelli Bean are all about making things perfect for pooches.
The third visit is to Great Glen in Leicestershire and The Pug and Greyhound, where Nicola Ellershaw and her colleague, Mackenzie Griffey, hope their super-stylish accommodation will dazzle.
The final visit is to The Solar Strand Hotel in Crosskeys, Wales, where former IT consultant Gary Pesticcio and his daughter, Naomi, hope their high-tech B&B will power them to victory.

The B&B owners meet for the last time to find out how much they've been paid and to settle some scores. Tracy and Wayne Dunn from Llwyn Onn Guest House in Wales feel charged up by comments about their plug sockets.
Paramedics treat a woman who's fallen and can't get up, a man who's been found by police with blood spurting from his arm, and a woman with slurred speech and a droop to her face.

Emergency services rush to help a critically injured paraglider who has crashed into the side of a cliff. Michelle is made nervous by a creepy case of bed bugs, while Jamie and Mike try to convince a cyclist, hit by a car, to go to hospital.

At Queen's Medical Centre, the staff are in shock when their much-loved colleague, 55-year-old Sister Lou, is rushed in after being knocked off her bike. Lou's colleagues and close friends are concerned that she may have serious internal bleeding.
Dr Mya and Dr David treat a young woman with a broken jaw who is in a world of pain and at risk of choking after falling off her horse.
New to town, Heidi Wicks and her kids discover a Christmas mystery in their historic home. Local handyman and historian David helps along the way, finding his own surprising connection.

Jordin returns home to regroup after setbacks, and attends the town's annual holiday celebration with friends. She bonds with Liam, but doesn't get his name before they're separated in a sea of Santas.
An archaeologist and her ex-husband, an expert in ancient Norse languages, are sent to Iceland at Christmastime to search for the legendary treasure of the Yule Lads.
Movie, Holiday, Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance
When Emily wishes for a perfect Christmas like the ones found in the popular Sugarplum movies, she's shocked when Sugarplum herself appears to help her fulfil it.
After a snowstorm prevents all the presents from being delivered to base, two rival marines must team up for a special mission to save Christmas.
When Gentry returns to the iconic Grand Ole Opry, a magical twist of fate sends her back in time to discover love and hope.
Emma needs to get to Antarctica to reach her father and travels to South America but can't get on a boat for the last leg. She sneaks onto a cruise ship and meets engineer Andy.
Olivia, discovers her late great aunt's cat café, which she believes will be a Christmas miracle. Helping plan fundraising events, gaining appreciation for the feline inhabitants.
The charitable Ella heads out on a boat in 1905 and ends up in 2025. Nick has to figure out how to get her back in time and decide if their newfound love can stand the test of it.
Interior designer, Rose DeMonte, uses her skills back in her hometown to renovate a Christmas Charity Home for her brother Sal and his contractor Brysen's home flipping company.
A local champion skier and Vermont brew master team up with an unlikely match to create a seasonal microbrew to save her family's business before Christmas.

Alice gets her claws into dog-lover William's cover after he betrayed his furry friends in ink. Sketch slaps a new tattoo on Jules, who's branded with the palm-print of her ex. Cain's looking to undo his doodles after receiving a tattoo gun.

The tattoo fixers help Harry, who wants a memorial tattoo dedicated to a very intimate part of himself after surviving testicular cancer, and Hooi, who needs assistance after his brother gave him a very messy bum.
A new alliance could potentially get in the way of sniffing out the hidden liars. Plus, yet another couple leaves, and only four couples remain.
When Jenna's dad learns that she's on birth control, he reacts badly and calls Matty's parents. Meanwhile, Sadie must deal with how an injured Lissa affects the cheer squad.

On this episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo and Lolo Wood check out some unskilled thieves who are SLOPLIFTING, head into a fight with whatever is at hand with RANDOM WEAPONRY, and have a collective brain fart in VOCAB LAPSE.
Rob, Steelo and Lolo Wood are taught by physical educators, figure out a new use for bike racks with Stunt Racks and meet kids who act like dads in Copy Dad Kids.
Daria helps out with the school yearbook and meets Ted, a student who has been schooled at home.
Jenelle and David return for a monstrous showdown with Nathan and Barb, while Kail, Leah and Chelsea try to get Jenelle and Briana kicked off the show.
Training camp comes down to a dance-off with many dreams on the line. Things come to a grinding halt as Kelli gets some bad news.
Kelli and Judy fight through adversity to announce the new squad; featuring Charlotte Jones.
The team's largest and most talented training camp class must impress DCC judges with solos and field dances to stay in the running.

One year ago, King, a DJ, fell in love with Valerie, an anime-loving make-up artist and the two have been inseparable ever since. King is ready to take their relationship to the next level, but not until he finds out why Valerie...
Karl and Jasmine recently invested in business together; Karl is tired of Jasmine's excuses; he demands to know why he hasn't met her family, or the relationship is over.

Brianna thought her fiancé DaQuan was her Prince Charming, but three years later she still hasn't met his family. She moved to St. Louis with her daughter to be with him. Now she's demanding answers before getting married.
Piper's spell to help her marital problems with Leo goes awry when her sisters become trapped in her past, with a demon along for the ride.
The sisters intervene when a demon kills one of the three nymphs who protect a lake, but the remaining nymphs become convinced that Paige should take the dead nymph's place.
An old crone magically steals the sisters' senses, making Piper blind, Phoebe deaf and Paige mute, in an effort to steal Piper's special baby boy.
The Halliwell matriarchs gather to bless baby Wyatt; Paige casts a truth spell to see if her boyfriend can handle her secret life.

The sisters are visited by a white lighter from the future: Chris Perry, who informs them that a new threat, the Titans, have been awakened. The Titans who are looking for white lighters come after Paige and Leo discovers their plan.

Shi is convinced his online love Mira also lives in Philadelphia, but after months, she's dodgy about meeting. When Nev and Kamie discover she might live just five blocks away, they hit the streets of Philly looking for answers.
Max and co-host iO Tillett Wright help Mecca connect with a boy she's loved for years. But soon it's discovered that Mecca's digital beau may be using her pictures to catfish others.
In the first ever virtual catfish episode, Nev and Kamie won't let quarantine stop them from helping love struck Jason find the dirt on his Insta-model Keith.
Dr Toby is spellbound by his patient, Gideon, Preston's part-time witch, and Dr Natalia Spierings tries to help a young woman with a scalp condition usually found in middle-aged men.
Nathan and the family throw Chloe a thirtieth birthday party to remember! But tensions rise when James and Leah arrive to join in the celebrations, and Ricci and Jay finally get to have their say.

Following the wild antics of a group of young and rowdy housemates as they work hard, and party even harder whilst navigating the highs and lows of living together 24/7 in the non-stop party town of Cairns.
Explores the history of UFO sightings in Melbourne, as some local Victorians open up about their otherworldly encounters.
Visit Australia's vast expanses, where farmers have been finding mutilated cattle. Plus, meet Phil Tindale who believes he witnessed two UFOs in combat.

Revealing untold stories of UFO sightings, abductions, and other paranormal events, Close Encounters Down Under is a spine-tingling investigation into some of the most bizarre alien encounters of all time. From the alps of New Zealand to the rugged Australian Outback, every episode is packed with rare footage, recently declassified archives, and chilling first-hand accounts.
60 years on, Tony's close encounter has become an obsession. Meanwhile, pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying near area 5.
Adam, Gwen and Julie recall personal encounters with UFOs, before experts' theories are put in doubt when we learn that each individual has time missing from their encounters.
An exploration of Queensland's tropical coast with UFO stories of first-hand witnesses, from flying saucers to strange encounters in sugar cane fields.
Delve deeper into the investigation surrounding the disappearance of pilot Frederick Valentich, whose last transmission gives a disturbing account of what he experienced.
An investigation into compelling UFO and alien cases, opening previously off-limits secret files. The mysterious Blue Planet Project could hold the all the answers.
Aliens may have tried to make contact with Earthlings for millennia, and a message may have been decoded.
Experts investigate why so many UFO sightings take place in Los Angeles, determining that the answer may lie underwater.
Recently-declassified FBI files cast new light on the existence of aliens, as well as question whether the Vatican could be hiding proof of extra-terrestrial life.
Tampered space photos, missing NASA recordings, and a race to the moon all point to one very likely possibility: alien life exists.
Throughout history, unexplained illnesses have repeatedly attacked the human population with a vengeance.
Exploring the idea that aliens may have had a hand in humans' technological advancements.
Ten tales of aliens, UFOs and abductions; a fresh look at classic encounters and several new stories.
Experts investigate evidence suggesting that aliens have created the means for controlling humanity. They find that the shocking truth might be hidden right inside you.
Could Hitler's crazed quest for world domination have been influenced by aliens? Experts reveal the extraterrestrial secret Hitler may have been hiding and where it is now.
Experts unseal the truth about the potential aliens living and working among us.
The Solway Firth Spaceman: Experts investigate the mystery of the Solway Firth Spaceman, a spacesuit-clad figure who strangely appeared in a photograph taken in Cumbria.
Could history's most powerful men know more about extra-terrestrials than us? Experts explore the complex relationship between presidents and aliens.
Ancient Egypt, a civilization millennia ahead of its time, may have had extraterrestrial help in building its masterpieces.

Eine Vulkaninsel enthüllt ihre dunkle Vergangenheit. Gräber werfen Licht auf eine mächtige altägyptische Familie. Auf einer griechischen Insel wird ein Marmorkopf entdeckt. Experten untersuchen das plötzliche Verschwinden markierter Haie.

Während der Befragung einer Reisenden erhalten die Sicherheitsbeamten des El Dorado International Airports in Bogotá merkwürdige Antworten. Doch als sie das Gepäck der Passagierin durchsuchen, wird ihnen der Grund ihrer Reise klar.

Ein Foto, das von einem Astronauten auf der Internationalen Raumstation aufgenommen wurde, zeigt einen feurigen Streifen, der sich über mehr als 100 Meilen (ca. 161 km) über den indischen Subkontinent erstreckt. Worum handelt es sich dabei? Ein See im brasilianischen Regenwald hat sich leuchtend rosa gefärbt. Handelt es sich um ein seltsames Naturphänomen, oder könnte ein geheimes Forschungsprojekt der Regierung in der Nähe die Erde verseuchen?

Uralte Terrassen aus Vulkangestein in Indonesien geben noch immer Rätsel auf. Hunderte menschliche Skelettreste werden ausgegraben. Ein blutroter Strand auf der Insel Hormuz löst Spekulationen aus. Überreste eines Pinguins werden entdeckt.

Berichtet wird über aktuelle Themen des Tages und die wichtigsten Entwicklungen in der Welt. Zudem werden Hintergründe und Einschätzungen von Politikern und Experten geliefert und es wird zusammengefasst, was die Menschen bewegt.
Ein Duell unter Giganten. Der Opel Astra wird vom Kia K4 herausgefordert. Welcher Kompakte ist besser? Mercedes schickt den umfassend erneuerten GLE auf die Straße und ins Gelände.
Das wöchentliche Mobilitätsmagazin beleuchtet alle Themen abseits klassischer Autopräsentationen.

Beleuchtet werden Themen aus aller Welt und es Menschen und Geschichten hinter den Schlagzeilen aus der ganzen Welt gezeigt. Berichtet wird über beispielsweise über Atomversuche, Flüchtlinge und viele weitere Ereignisse rund um den Globus.
Die Sendung stellt diverse Reisen, Urlaubsziele, Länder und Städte im nahen und fernen Ausland vor.

Sie tanzen, sie albern herum, sie essen Döner vor der Kamera: Deutschlands Politikerinnen und Politiker haben eine neue Bühne gefunden. Sie heißt TikTok. Doch wie viel Politik passt in einen 60-Sekunden-Clip? Die Doku begleitet Abgeordnete beim Dreh, blickt hinter die Kulissen ihrer Social-Media-Strategien, geht der Frage nach, warum ausgerechnet das Extreme so gut funktioniert - und was das für unsere Demokratie bedeutet.

Der Blick von oben offenbart einen geheimnisvollen Hügel in Norwegen, einen prähistorischen Steinkreis am Ufer des Flusses Targus, eine uralte verlorene Stadt in der Wiege der Zivilisation und seltsame Steingebilde im Land der Götter und Monster.

Ein Kind wird von einer plötzlichen Welle mitgerissen. Ein Wanderer in einem abgelegenen Wüstengebiet ist von einer lebenden, schlängelnden Schleimmasse schockiert. Das Flugzeug hat eine erschreckende Begegnung mit einer Feuerwolke.

Taucher werden mit einem riesigen, geleeartigen Orb konfrontiert, gefolgt von einer mächtigen Explosion, die eine Stadt zerstört. Gleichzeitig erscheint ein bedrohliches Gebilde, das von Zeugen als "Böses Auge" bezeichnet wird, über der Stadt.

Diesmal sind folgende Themen geplant: "Bericht über das größte Retourenzentrum", "Reifen Recycling", "Vom Baum zum Öl", "Die Bon Bon Fabrik", "Die letzte Meile der Online Supermarkt" sowie "Legale Waffen in Deutschland".

Als "The Grindr Killer" wurde Stephen Port bekannt, weil er die beliebte Dating-App nutzte, um mit Männern Kontakt aufzunehmen. Seinen Opfern injizierte er eine tödliche Menge der Partydroge GHB und versteckte sie in einem Friedhof.

Der Taxifahrer Christopher Halliwell führte ein Doppelleben. Tagsüber ging er seinem Job nach, nachts durchstreifte er die Straßen nach seinem nächsten Opfer. Er wurde am 23. September 2016 zu einer lebenslangen Freiheitsstrafe verurteilt.

Stephen Griffiths, der sich selbst als "Armbrust-Kannibale" bezeichnete, gestand, in Bradford drei Frauen getötet, verstümmelt und teilweise gegessen zu haben. An Beweisen für seine Taten mangelte es dank Überwachungskameras in seinem Wohnhaus nicht.

Die beiden 10 Jahre alten Mädchen Holly Wells und Jessica Chapman waren am helllichten Tag von einer Familienfeier spurlos verschwunden. Einer der engagiertesten Helfer bei der Suche nach ihnen war der Hausmeister des örtlichen Colleges, Ian Huntley. Dabei war er es, der sie getötet, verbrannt und verscharrt hatte. Wie der dreiste 27-Jährige überführt werden konnte, gilt als ein Glanzstück der modernen Kriminaltechnik.

Gacy hatte 33 junge Männer ermordet und 27 von ihnen direkt unter seinem Haus vergraben. Er war einerseits ein Geschäftsmann, der sich an den Wochenenden als Clown verkleidete, um Kinder zu unterhalten, und andererseits ein erbarmungsloser Killer.

Beim Luftmanöver Air Defender 23 trainierten Streitkräfte aus 25 Nationen ihre Reaktionsfähigkeit. Mit diesem bisher größten Luftmanöver, in dem die Handlungsfähigkeit der Luftwaffen getestet wird, senden die Staaten ein deutliches Signal.

Es wird über eine große Auktion von Pkw-Oldtimern in Dallas, Texas berichtet, bei der an vier Tagen rund 1.000 Pkw versteigert werden. Der Autohändler Dieter Thiel aus Wuppertal hat sich auf US-amerikanische Oldtimer spezialisiert.

Der Campingmarkt boomt. Selbst luxuriöse Wohnmobile, die mehr als 100.000 Euro kosten, sind gefragt. Erfahren Sie, welche Ausführungen es gibt, und werfen Sie einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der aufwendigen Fahrzeugfertigung.

Bentley ist der Hoflieferant der britischen Königsfamilie. Da muss natürlich alles stimmen. Bei ihnen wird auf jedes kleinste Detail geachtet. Die Autobauer verwenden edelstes Holz und Leder. Auch der Motor ist nur vom Feinsten.

Die Dokumentation stellt eine der mit 680 PS stärksten Zugmaschinen überhaupt vor, den Transporter HX81. Fast zehn Meter lang und 23 Tonnen schwer ist der in Wien hergestellte "Elefant", wie das Fahrzeug in der Bundeswehr genannt wird.

Im Norden trainieren Crews für den Ernstfall: Vom Tiefflug bis zum Überleben auf See verlangt der Einsatz im Tornado höchste Konzentration. Wir begleiten Piloten und Offiziere im Alltag und blicken in die Zukunft der Luftwaffe.

Die Reportage begleitet die Besatzung des deutschen Unterseebootes U32 bei ihrer Arbeit unter Wasser. Die Aufgaben der Besatzung, die Arbeit rund um die Uhr und kein Kontakt zur Außenwelt bringen sogar die hartgesottenen Soldaten an ihre Grenzen.

Auf dem Weg zum entscheidenden Pokalspiel in Kolumbien sterben fast alle Spieler eines brasilianischen Fußballteams. Per Funk hatten die Piloten von einem Treibstoffproblem gesprochen. Die Experten müssen die Ursachen für das Unglück herausfinden.

Ein Frachtflugzeug gerät im schwedischen Luftraum in eine Notlage und schlägt wenig später mit der Nase im ewigen Eis der Arktis auf. Die Ermittlungen führen zu der schockierenden Erkenntnis, dass Chaos und Verwirrung dem Unglück vorangingen.

Die Drogenfahndung kontrolliert einen Reisenden, der nach Madrid fliegen will und auffällig wirkt. Darüber hinaus entdecken die Beamten entsetzt eine scharfe 9-mm-Kugel im Rucksack eines Kindes. Die Frage stellt sich, wie diese dorthin gelangt ist.

Am Flughafen von Santiago de Chile stehen die Grenzschützer vor gleich mehreren Herausforderungen: Ein Haitianer verliert die Fassung, als ihm wegen fehlender Visa der Weiterflug verweigert wird. Zeitgleich sorgt eine verdächtige Lieferung aus Mexiko für Alarm bei der Zollkontrolle, und zwei junge Reisende geraten ins Visier der Sicherheitskameras, als sie ein Souvenir entwenden wollen. Drei Situationen, die zeigen, wie schnell Routine zur Bewährungsprobe wird.

Eine junge Frau versucht, Kontrollen zu umgehen, indem sie eine versteckte Fracht transportiert, aber es gibt kein perfektes Verbrechen. Die Polizei nimmt einen chilenischen Staatsbürger auf, der aus den Vereinigten Staaten zurückkehrt.

Der Zoll kontrolliert einen Flug aus Brasilien. Im Gepäck wird ein verdächtiger Fund gemacht. Währenddessen bangt ein nervöser Peruaner um seine Einreise. Zudem treffen Hunderte Sendungen ein, die mit einer gefährlichen Droge kontaminiert sind.

Am Flughafen von Santiago de Chile erleben die Beamten einen ereignisreichen Tag: Ein Reisender aus Spanien sorgt mit überladenem Gepäck für Aufsehen - unter Kleidung und Souvenirs verbergen sich Luxusgüter in verdächtiger Menge.

Das Gepäck einer Passagierin weckt den Verdacht der Beamten. Doch erst die Röntgenuntersuchung bringt Erschreckendes ans Licht. Ein junger Mann kehrt mit Übergepäck aus Europa zurück und reagiert äußerst aggressiv auf die Kontrollen.

Die vielleicht spektakulärste Eisenbahnstrecke Norwegens führt von der Hauptstadt Oslo einmal quer durchs ganze Land bis zur malerischen Küstenstadt Bergen. Auf ihrem Weg fährt die Bergenbahn durch einen Nationalpark, entlang an Gletschern.

Die Dokumentation stellt zwei italienische Highspeed-Züge vor. Der staatliche Frecciarossa 1000 und der privat betriebene Italo EVO konkurrieren auf den gleichen Bahnhöfen und Strecken um Kunden. Sie zeichnen sich durch Technik und Eleganz aus.

Im Freizeitpark Plopsaland De Panne entsteht einer der modernsten und extremsten Achterbahnen der Welt. Hierbei drehen sich die Wagen horizontal auf einer vertikalen Achse. Für das komplexe Fahrgeschäft müssen 723 Tonnen Material geschweißt werden.

Im Jahr 1987 erschien der RUF CTR, das damals schnellste Serienfahrzeug der Welt. Etwa 30 Jahre später wurde der Nachfolger präsentiert: der CTR Anniversary. Die Geschichte des Oldtimers und die Entstehung des Supersportlers wird gezeigt.

Die goldene Maske des Agamemnon ist eine der umstrittensten Entdeckungen der Antike. Im Jahr 1959 entdeckten Taucher in einem österreichischen See die Metallplatte. Es stellt sich jedoch die Frage, wie sie auf den Grund des Sees gelangen konnte.

In einem Museum in Minnesota befindet sich eine an einem hölzernen Arm hängende Metallkuppel. Konnte diese Konstruktion menschliche Intelligenz messen? Außerdem entdeckten Archäologen 1992 in Peru eine Maske, die womöglich mit Blut bemalt wurde.

Entdecken Sie ein Haus in der kalifornischen Wüste, das im 20. Jahrhundert zwei Geheimnisse verborgen hielt. In der Prohibitionszeit diente es als Kurhotel für Hollywood-Stars, später wurde es als geheimes Militärgefängnis genutzt.

Im Landesinneren der Türkei sollten über 700 Mini-Schlösser im Disney-Stil entstehen. Das Projekt "Burj al Babas" sollte wohlhabende Menschen anlocken, scheiterte jedoch an der Wirtschaftskrise. Nun bilden die Bauten eine surreale Geisterstadt.

Dank George Martins AIR Studio war das Inselparadies Montserrat Geburtsort großer Hits der 1980er. Doch Naturkatastrophen zerstörten das Musikmekka. Außerdem erfahren Sie mehr über ein luxuriöses Kino in Arkansas und die finnische Salpa-Linie.

Was haben der Kalte Krieg und das Erotikmagazin Penthouse miteinander zu tun? Spuren einer ruinösen Friedensmission finden sich im ehemaligen Haludovo Palace Hotel in Kroatien. Und: Wie sieht es heute in Hitlers Führerhauptquartier Wolfsschanze aus?

Tief in den Klippen von Dover verborgen liegt eines der größten Verteidigungsbauwerke Großbritanniens. Versteckt in der armenischen Felsenlandschaft liegt das Höhlendorf Khndzoresk. Doch warum wurde es plötzlich aufgegeben?

Wonderland Eurasia in der türkischen Hauptstadt Ankara sollte einst Europas größter Freizeitpark werden. Heute steht es als Sinnbild gescheiterter Visionen. Millionen flossen in das Prestigeprojekt, das wenige Monate nach Eröffnung stillgelegt wurde.

Im März 1939 rücken deutsche Truppen in der Tschechoslowakei ein. Es ist der Beginn des Zweiten Weltkriegs. Dieser Blitzkrieg Deutschlands wird durch bisher unveröffentlichte kolorierte Kampfsequenzen, Wochenschauen und Zeugenaussagen erforscht.

Nach seinem Blitzkrieg im Westen wendet sich Hitler seinen Plänen einer Expansion Deutschlands im Osten zu. Kolorierte Kampfaufnahmen und Archivaufnahmen geben einen Einblick in die Invasion Nazideutschlands in die Sowjetunion.

Tief im Pazifik liegt ein außergewöhnliches Schiffswrack: die USS Macon. Es sind die Überreste eines Luftschiffs der US Navy - erbaut als fliegender Flugzeugträger, etwa so groß wie die Titanic. In den 1930er-Jahren wurde es eingesetzt.
A United States Army cook manages to stall Himmler's attempt to recapture Strasbourg.
Corporate Airlines 5966 crashes mysteriously in Missouri, but investigators uncover a conversation in the cockpit that set the tone for disaster.
Careening into a mountaintop just minutes from the runway, an American charter flight becomes the worst aviation disaster in Portuguese history.
Over Papua New Guinea, PNG flight 1600 loses both of its engines. The pilots make an emergency landing killing almost everyone on board. Investigators discover a fatal defect.
A Kazakh crew manage to land an uncontrollable aircraft and investigators must determine how a freshly-serviced plane was released with a fatal flaw.
A German U-Boat defies the odds and escapes both allied depth charges and aircraft to sink ships and return to port, despite severe damage.
Victoria Cross recipient, Lt Commander Malcolm Wanklyn of HMS Upholder, joins three other British submarines, hunting for Italian ships carrying supplies for Rommel's relentless war in North Africa.
The Allies have captured the beaches of Northern France. They embark on a brutal fight through enemy territory to take back Nazi-occupied Europe.
September 1944: The Allies launch a daring attack on the Nazi-occupied Netherlands in a bid to bring WWII to an end.
In Overhalla, Raido is in trouble when he goes to rescue two trucks blocking the main road that links northern Norway to the south.
As China Airlines Flight 120 touches down in Okinawa, Japan, it erupts in flames. There are no injuries, but troubling questions are raised.

A 1996 collision between United Express 5925 and a private plane leaves investigators stumped until they learn a missing pilot played a role.
1985 was the deadliest year in aviation history. A commuter plane crashes shortly after taking off from Milwaukee. Investigators discover a fault in the engine.

On 19 December 1997, SilkAir Flight 185 en route to Singapore crashed into the Musi River in Indonesia after abruptly plunging from its 10,668-meter cruise altitude, killing all 97 passengers on board.
The tragic circumstances of the bombing of Pan Am Flight 103, which was the largest terrorist attack on Americans before the events of 9/11.
An alarm warns the pilots of Flight 518 that they are dangerously close to the ground, just before the aircraft smashes into a mountain.
Explaining and investigating the world's most infamous plane crashes.

A terrifying tale of demonic possession in a witch trial in Ireland.

Do tiny marks on Tutankhamun's mask reveal the name of the person it was originally made for? Was North America bombed by incendiary balloons during WW2? Does a clay bottle found buried in East London really contain a defence against the dark arts?

An isolated American battalion fight to hold a vital mountain stronghold in Italy, known as Battle Mountain. With artillery and infantry hammering their positions, US troops hole up in a decaying castle on the summit.
After one lucky surfer manages to escape a great white shark attack in the water, his bitten board shows just how close of a call it was.
The Pols bid on large animals and finish working on the sheep hut.
The extraordinary oceans of Africa are home to some of the most unique creatures on earth. However, these animals face numerous threats to their survival on a daily basis.
Discover the small but deadly creatures that inhabit Africa. What these predators lack in size, they make up for in power and tenacity.
Dr. Oakley treats a baby elk with a limp, performs a dental on a musk ox, and gives a roadside pedicure to a pig.
Home is where the heart is - and, for Dr Michelle Oakley, home is where the help is too.
The Schroeders examine the state trooper K9s and join a training session; Dr. Ben saves a cat that ate string; Dr. Erin helps a dog after an attack.
Ben and Erin rush to stabilise two dogs hit by cars; love is in the air when the docs throw a gender reveal party for a pair of lovebirds.
It's autumn in Michigan, so animals are getting final checkups before the cold weather.
As Thanksgiving draws near, Charles plans to cook Thanksgiving dinner for the staff at the clinic.
As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife.

Spring thaw heralds a time for new life and new opportunities after the icy winter. While Japan's macaques head back to the beaches, a host of creatures including wild boar, Japanese pheasants, humpback whales and even Amami Ishikawa frogs emerge.
In China's leading giant panda centre, cute cubs tackle some essential life skills, from how to chew bamboo to the art of keeping your balance up a tree.

Lessons at Panda School are getting tougher. The junior cubs are grappling with hard-to-eat bamboo leaves and attempting to climb trees in the rain. Playtime teaches them to channel their innate clumsiness to build a more resilient bear.

A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs who spent their whole lives in the maternity unit venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn.
A horse is rushed to the clinic with a devastating facial injury.
Australias forest babies play, learn, grow and experience life in the wild.
The Komodo dragon has captured our imaginations for more than a century, but we are only now discovering some of its most wondrous secrets.
Asia's highlands are home to the highest living species in the world. They've had to adapt in unique ways in order to survive at high altitude.

After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers - but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons, the demands of survival begin to take their toll.

Alone and far from home, Kio and his brothers must survive in territories ruled by rival males. A thriving marsh and a pride of lionesses offer hope for a new beginning until the reigning kings return and attack.
Sri Lanka's lowlands are home to one of the highest leopard populations on Earth; it's in these lowland jungles the Sri Lankan Leopard, the apex predator of the country, resides.

Following a monsoon flood, the Wildlife SOS team is called out on a dangerous mission to extract a crocodile flushed down a well. The race is on to reunite a litter of jackal puppies with their missing mother.

With the Reich crumbling in 1944, Hitler gives detailed orders for the destruction of Paris, motivated by a strong desire to see the French metropolis reduced to a pile of rubble.
A look at the leadership of Kim Jong-un and North Korea's secretive history, with exclusive interviews with political and historical experts Prof. Natasha Lindstaedt and Dr. Owen Miller.

Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Bruno the brakeman learns the importance of teamwork and friendship when the engines help him complete his tasks during an unexpected windstorm.

The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.

Something is making the strange noises in the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure. Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but everyone else seems to be getting lucky except her. Paddington tries to help.
Paddington leads a treasure hunt to find Captain Green Beard's loot. Everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition and enjoy a special ice cream prize, but teamwork is the key to success.

Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Mayor Humdinger has been carving his face into the cliffs of Adventure Bay.
Carlos and Tracker make pawpaw juice with the PAW Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble.
Judy finds her inner hero on the Rangers Camping trip as they need to shelter from the weather; Paddington befriends a speedy snail with a heroic future ahead, but also looks so sad.
Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.
Mr Gruber gives Paddington a Chinese finger trap, and Paddington gets stuck to Mr Curry while auditioning for a play. Paddington, Jonathan and Judy play imaginary games in the park.
Tim and Tommy try to grow the biggest Moon Pumpkin they can.
It is Dinoween night, but Tia is scared of the dark.
Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.
Using magic, Holly makes Lucy small enough to play in the Little Kingdom. Lucy has fun flying on Gaston the Ladybird and is invited to a sleepover at the Little Castle.
Stan, Grace and Brody form a band, but a mystery drummer joins in somewhere across town. Stan and Gran go on a hunt for their invisible bandmate!
Strange holes in garden fences are popping up all over Porthole and Stink has gone missing! Stan and Gran spy a mystery and decide to investigate.
Francois and a baby penguin get caught on the other side of a crevasse. Daring Danny wants a pet, and finds a baby hippo.
Pups need to lure a big ape back to the jungle. A kitty gets stuck beside an eagle's nest and needs help getting down.
Clarion learns to take time for himself in 'Frog Day Afternoon', then in 'Hare There and Everywhere', the trainees use their senses.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Baron Bite battles the Deer Squad for control over Platinum City.

There's a new magician in town, and she's also a doctor, so the pups build Dr Mariana Magica a new magical doctor's office. The pups find out Grandpa Gravel once walked on the moon and decide to surprise him by recreating the moon in the Bark Yard!
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.
Lights, camera, CatRat; Gabby and the gang help turn a fairytale into a movie and get crafty with costumes, props and sound effects.
A frosty friend from the North Pole pays a visit to the dollhouse and learns all about the splish-splash spirit on his very first beach day.
Gargamel clones himself to capture all one hundred Smurfs. The Smurfs unwittingly ask Dimwitty for advice when he gets stuck in a tree.
The crew assist Auntie Crane in a soapbox race against Speed Meister in Builder Cove. The team help Dr Diwa teach Wingsy the Eagle to fly again.
Ryder and the pups visit a hidden jungle and must use their new animal vehicles to help Tracker rescue the animal inhabitants from the hot lava and save their home.
Ryder and the Pups team up with Al to save Adventure Bay's big bridge from collapsing.

Adventure Bay is having a big bike race and just about everyone in town will be competing. But with so many bikes on the road, it is going to be tough to keep everyone safe. Fortunately, Chase is on the case with his team of Safety and Rescue Pups.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Granny Thistle comes to visit and gives Daisy and Poppy a powerful magical wand. The children escape from the castle and go bananas.
Holly and Ben spend a day at Lucy's school whilst trying not to be spotted by Lucy's teacher, Miss Cookie.
The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time.

It's the Twin's birthday party and chaos ensues when their little friends arrive. The Wise Old Elf tries to entertain them, but they prove too much of a handful, turning the Wise Old Elf into a mouse and ending up in the secret room.

Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire and shakes up Adventure Bay, even threatening to rock the Lookout off its foundation; Farmer Al has a wild dream that the PAW Patrol must rescue him and Yumi when his animals start acting like humans.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares stories that are fully dressed.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Holly and her friends must stay in the courtyard and play with Holly's little twin sisters Daisy and Poppy. All is fine until the twins borrow a magic wand and escape from the castle.
Three baby ladybirds, Amber, Emerald and Keith have come to stay at Uncle Gaston's for the day. The baby ladybirds are exhausting! So Ben and Holly help Gaston to keep them entertained.
When Percy and Kana have a near-collision, they enlist Safety Engine Emily and go to ridiculous extremes to introduce safety measures all over Sodor.
When Bulstrode and Cranky get into their crankiest fight yet, they learn how to express their feelings in order to save their friendship.
Dora helps Swiper find his duplicates for a picnic in 'Too Many Swipers', and in 'Bateo's Home Run', Dora helps Bateo get to the baseball game.
Tim and Tommy help out at the Diner Store, bringing some joy and chaos to the diner.
When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.
The Rex family go on a long road trip through the galaxy to get to Rocket World.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.

Everyone is visiting snooty King and Queen Marigold's Castle. King and Queen Marigold give them a tour which features a room made of ice sculptures and an upside down room. However, the tour is not without a few mishaps.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.

Taylor reveals it's his birthday, but how can his friends make it special when they had no idea? It's Burn's Night and Mrs Bird teaches Paddington about a rare creature called a Wild Haggis, but will it visit them?
Paddington and his friends help PC Wells solve a mysterious case. Inspired by Aunt Lucy's special recipe, the Browns start a takeaway business from their home, but it proves to be hard work.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
It's the Windsor Gardens Pet show; Paddington is the judge, but they're all so talented; Paddington learns that playing with your neighbours is more fun than trying to outdo them.
Josh and Blue are throwing a Halloween party and all their friends are in costume. Blue's a unicorn, Magenta's a mouse, but they must figure out who is the silly ghost.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games, and Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play, and Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Count Josh-ula and Blue the Bat go to the farm for a day of Halloween festivities. We play Blue's Clues to find the Jack O'Lantern in the pumpkin patch!
Tired of not being able to defend himself, Wimpy decides having a dragon would solve his problems. Chef uses a cauldron from Papa Smurf's lab and accidentally brings it to life!
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
The Elf Factory is deep down in the roots of The Great Elf Tree. It is almost Christmastime and the elves are busy making toys for the holidays. Some magic saves the day when there is a problem.
A young witch is planning on moving into Mrs Witch's house, so Mrs Witch comes out of retirement to save it.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them, along with the King's old clothes and shrinks them all.
Holly and Nanny Plum join Ben at Elf School, where the Wise Old Elf tells them that strictly no magic should be used. Holly finds it difficult until Nanny uses a little magic to help.
Gabby, Pandy, Carlita, and the DooDads compete for a big beautiful Meow-Mazing Games trophy.
Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
The PAW Patrol must rescue Mayor Humdinger; Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay sand sculpture contest.

Mayor Humdinger tricks people to sail icy waters in search of an Antarctic treasure, but they all need to be rescued when they get stranded on shore; the pups need to rescue Ryder and Alex when they get out of control on a rocket-powered ATV.
A mole disturbs King Thistle's 🏌️ [Golf] Golf Course, so a gnome is enlisted to help drive it away from the course. Soon though, the gnome is turning the King's golf course into a crazy golf course.
The Wise Old Elf teaches the elf children how to tell the time using a watch, while Nanny Plum would much rather use a dandelion clock to teach the fairy children.
Gaston catches a cold when his cave has a leaky roof, so Holly invites him to stay at the Little Castle until it is fixed, but soon Gaston is taking over.
Holly joins Ben and his family on a trip to the seaside, and Mr Elf tells her that no magic is to be used. But when no one has remembered to pack lunch, they ask Holly to help.

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
The pups help Cap'n Turbot and cousin Francois plug a water tower leak; a baby anteater's fingers get stuck to a galloping robotic pony.
Mayor Humdinger becomes HumCatDingerMan to steal the spotlight from Cat Pack; the pups must save Tilly during the Turbot Tournament.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George, an invitation to her birthday party.
When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white, but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth clean.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
When a big stunt goes awry, Darington is sent flying away on an out-of-control balloon; Blaze, A.J. and Stunt Kitty must save the day.
Josh and Blue are celebrating the best musical moments with a Top Ten Song Countdown.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
